comment: Example cron-job.org job for keeping the Nexus browser worker awake. Placeholders only — replace YOUR-RAILWAY-URL with your real Railway service URL (e.g. nexus-browser-worker-production). No real URL, no API key: /health needs no auth.
note: Ping GET /health every 5 minutes so the Railway free/trial service never sleeps and Nexus browsing jobs start instantly. Turn this job OFF (disable/delete in cron-job.org) when you are not using Nexus browsing for a while — an always-awake server spends Railway trial credit (~$5) continuously. Without a pinger the server sleeps and the first request takes ~1 min to wake it, which is free and fine for occasional use.
title: Nexus browser worker keep-alive
